question: Who assumed the role of Chairperson of the National Statistical Commission in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar** was appointed as the **Chairperson of the National Statistical Commission (NSC)** in 2022 by the Government of India.
 
• The **National Statistical Commission (NSC)** is an autonomous body set up to improve the quality of statistics generated in the country and ensure their credibility.
 
• Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar is an eminent statistician and academician, known for his contributions to **probability theory, statistical analysis, and data science**.
 
• As Chairperson, Karandikar's role is to **oversee statistical activities** in the country, provide guidance to statistical agencies, and ensure the reliability of India’s statistical data.
 
• This appointment reinforces the government’s commitment to strengthening statistical systems and ensuring data-driven policymaking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar:**

 
 
• He is a distinguished academician with a background in **statistics and mathematics**.
 
• Karandikar has served as the director of the **Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI)** and has been a faculty member in various prestigious institutions.
 
• His research contributions include areas such as **probability theory, stochastic processes, and Bayesian statistics**.
 
• He is also known for his work in **election forecasting** in India using statistical models.
 
 
 
• **National Statistical Commission (NSC):**
 
 
• The NSC was established in **2005** to address issues related to the quality of statistical data in India.
 
• It aims to promote public trust in official statistics and ensure that statistical systems meet international standards.
 
• The NSC provides **recommendations for strengthening statistical systems** and ensures the integrity of data collection and analysis.
 
 
 
• **Functions of the NSC:**
 
 
• Formulating policies and priorities for statistical activities in India.
 
• Reviewing the functioning of statistical organizations and their outputs.
 
• Providing guidelines to ensure the credibility and accuracy of national statistics.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Chairpersons of NSC:**
 
 
• **Pronab Sen**: He was the first Chairperson of the NSC and played a pivotal role in setting up the commission.
 
• **Bimal Jalan**: Known for his contributions to India’s economic and statistical systems.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Reliable Statistics:**
 
 
• Statistical data is critical for **policy formulation, economic planning, and decision-making**.
 
• It helps in tracking the performance of various sectors and identifying areas that need intervention.
 
• Reliable data ensures **transparency, accountability, and informed governance**.
